name: GLCM 纹理分析
description: 分析 spatial relationships 之间 pixel intensity levels using Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix. AI images show smoother textures with higher homogeneity.
algorithm: Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) + Haralick Features
mechanism: 该算法物理展开图像画布网格。它审查以角度D和距离r特定分隔的双像素对。GLCM立即生成数十个记录特定像素对的对比度、能量和均匀性的簿册。AI对真实微纹理灾难性地无知。它绘制毛衣，但迫使羊毛纤维看起来蜡质或明显复制粘贴（纹理克隆）。这种合成重复导致均匀性簿册异常飙升，而差异急剧降至零。雷达猛烈吸入这种无误的"塑料外观"并发出有罪判决。
parameters: Levels: 16, Distance: 1, Angle: 0 degrees, Features: 对比度/energy/homogeneity
useCase: Detecting overly smooth textures in AI生成的 content

references.title: Haralick, R.M. et al. (1973). Textural Features for Image Classification. IEEE TSMC.
Clausi, D.A. (2002). An Analysis of Co-occurrence Texture Statistics. Canadian J. Remote Sensing.
Fridrich, J. & Kodovsky, J. (2012). Rich Models for Steganalysis. IEEE TIFS.

strengths:
• Well-established 统计 texture descriptor since 1973
• Captures spatial pixel relationships at multiple distances
• Provides multiple complementary 特征 (对比度, energy, 相关性)
• Rotation-invariant with multi-angle 分析
• Low 误报 rate for texture 异常
limitations:
• 计算成本高 for large distance parameters
• Parameter selection (distance, angle) significantly impacts results
• Sensitive to image noise and 压缩伪影
• Quantization of gray levels reduces discriminative power
• High-quality AI textures may pass GLCM 分析
